Receivables advance lets you receive eligible credit-sale amounts—whether paid in one installment or in installments—before their normal settlement date. You can request it in the Getnet Brasil app: sign in, go to **Services > Sales Advance**, choose a registered bank account, review and accept the terms, simulate the advance to check the amounts, card brands and rates, then confirm. The minimum advance amount is R$50. You can track the request under **My Orders**. The amount available and applicable rates are shown in the app simulation; the official information retrieved does not specify a universal rate or settlement time. Conditions may change, so confirm them through Getnet’s official channels.
